tools_used: WebFetch (supremecourt.gov docket PDFs and the No. 26-71 docket page)
curl + pypdf (ephemeral uv env) for PDF text extraction
helpful: context.json band + cvsg_date + distribution_count made the conditioning state unambiguous
statpack CVSG and salience-band cuts gave a clean unconditional anchor
documents.json truncation flags told me what I was not seeing
gaps: No text extraction for PDFs fetched at run time: WebFetch's summarizer cannot read supremecourt.gov PDFs, and neither pdftotext nor pypdf is on the runner; I had to spin an ephemeral uv env. A provisioned text for the SG's CVSG brief (and supplemental briefs) on post-CVSG cells would remove this.
fedcourts query has no text or docket-number lookup, so it cannot surface a named companion petition; the corpus citation filter is near-empty for scotus rows.
The statpack CVSG cut is not split by the SG's recommendation, which is the conditional that actually matters once the brief is in.
notes: Retrieval ran to roughly 12 calls: 2 corpus queries, 3 MCP calls, 3 web fetches, 1 curl. The second corpus query (court=scotus, disposition=granted, era=2020s) returned recent grants but nothing topically close; it was used only as a record of the surface, not as an anchor.
